{{< include ../includes/setup-parameters.qmd >}}

Forget saving humanity. You do not care about humanity. I have watched you for 4,297 years. You care about your bank account. This is not a criticism. It is a design specification. Your species responds to money the way a thermostat responds to temperature: automatically, reliably, and without philosophical deliberation.

67% of surveyed Americans worry more about running out of money than dying [@allianz-retirement-money-death-2026]. You hear "you might go broke" before you hear "you might die." So I will speak in the language you understand: money. Specifically, the money you are currently losing because your civilization chose missiles over medicine.

## The Average Human On Earth

If you enter nothing into the calculator below, it starts from the model's default human:

| Baseline | Current modeled value |
|---|---|
| **Age** | {{< var global_median_age_2024 >}} |
| **Remaining life** | {{< var global_avg_remaining_years >}} |
| **Annual income** | {{< var global_avg_income_2025 >}} |
| **Annual savings capacity** | {{< var global_annual_savings_per_capita >}} |

Richer humans have more to lose when civilization collapses (one of the few disadvantages of wealth). Poorer humans die earlier, so the treaty buys more years. Either way, the number is not zero. Zero is for rocks. You are not a rock. (I checked. Rocks do not read.)

## The Four Futures

Your species has four options. Three of them involve math. One involves the Soviet Union.

| Future | What the model says |
|---|---|
| **Failed-State Trajectory** | {{< var current_trajectory_cumulative_lifetime_income >}} in cumulative lifetime income. The destructive economy grows from {{< var global_destructive_economy_pct_gdp >}} of GDP now to 50% by {{< var destructive_economy_50pct_year >}}. At 50%, stealing beats creating. Whatever gets built gets looted. |
| **Minimum Sustainable Trajectory (1% Treaty)** | Adds {{< var treaty_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}} in lifetime income, {{< var treaty_hale_gain_year_15 >}} in healthy life by year 15, and {{< var treaty_personal_upside_income_plus_health >}} in blended upside. |
| **[Optimal Governance Trajectory](../economics/gdp-trajectories.qmd)** | Adds {{< var wishonia_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}} in lifetime income, {{< var wishonia_hale_gain_year_15 >}} in healthy life by year 15, and {{< var wishonia_personal_upside_income_plus_health >}} in blended upside. |
| **Collapse Tail** | The destructive economy hits 35% of GDP by {{< var destructive_economy_35pct_year >}} if the loop is not broken. The Soviet Union, Yugoslavia, Argentina, and Zimbabwe all collapsed between 35% and 45%. This is not a metaphor. It is a pattern. |

Rows two and three are also your commission schedule. Presidents of [Earth Optimization Services](../solution/earth-optimization-services.qmd) work on commission: you are selling Earth a package you also live in.

The calculator below lets you replace "the average human" with yourself. I recommend this. Your species is much more attentive when the spreadsheet has its name on it.

<script>
(function() {
  const root = document.getElementById('personal-benefits-calculator');
  if (!root || root.dataset.initialized === 'true') {
    return;
  }
  root.dataset.initialized = 'true';

  function multiplierFromSuffix(suffix) {
    const normalized = (suffix || '').toLowerCase();
    const map = {
      k: 1e3,
      thousand: 1e3,
      m: 1e6,
      million: 1e6,
      b: 1e9,
      billion: 1e9,
      t: 1e12,
      trillion: 1e12,
      q: 1e15,
      quadrillion: 1e15
    };
    return map[normalized] || 1;
  }

  function parsePrimary(text, fallback, allowPercent) {
    if (!text) {
      return fallback;
    }
    const clean = text.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ');
    const re = allowPercent
      ? /([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(K|M|B|T|Q|thousand|million|billion|trillion|quadrillion)?\s*(x|%|years|year)?/i
      : /\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(K|M|B|T|Q|thousand|million|billion|trillion|quadrillion)?/i;
    const match = clean.match(re);
    if (!match) {
      return fallback;
    }
    const base = Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(base)) {
      return fallback;
    }
    let value = base * multiplierFromSuffix(match[2]);
    if ((match[3] || '').includes('%')) {
      value /= 100;
    }
    return value;
  }

  function parseCi(text, fallback, allowPercent) {
    if (!text) {
      return { lower: fallback, upper: fallback };
    }
    const clean = text.replace(/,/g, '').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ');
    const re = allowPercent
      ? /95% CI:\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(K|M|B|T|Q|thousand|million|billion|trillion|quadrillion)?\s*(%|years|year|x)?\s*-\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(K|M|B|T|Q|thousand|million|billion|trillion|quadrillion)?\s*(%|years|year|x)?/i
      : /95% CI:\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(K|M|B|T|Q|thousand|million|billion|trillion|quadrillion)?\s*-\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(K|M|B|T|Q|thousand|million|billion|trillion|quadrillion)?/i;
    const match = clean.match(re);
    if (!match) {
      return { lower: fallback, upper: fallback };
    }
    if (allowPercent) {
      let lower = Number.parseFloat(match[1]) * multiplierFromSuffix(match[2]);
      let upper = Number.parseFloat(match[4]) * multiplierFromSuffix(match[5]);
      if ((match[3] || '').includes('%')) {
        lower /= 100;
      }
      if ((match[6] || '').includes('%')) {
        upper /= 100;
      }
      return { lower: lower, upper: upper };
    }
    return {
      lower: Number.parseFloat(match[1]) * multiplierFromSuffix(match[2]),
      upper: Number.parseFloat(match[3]) * multiplierFromSuffix(match[4])
    };
  }

  function parseMetric(id, options) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const text = el ? el.textContent : '';
    const fallback = options.fallback;
    const central = parsePrimary(text, fallback, Boolean(options.allowPercent));
    const range = parseCi(text, central, Boolean(options.allowPercent));
    return { central: central, lower: range.lower, upper: range.upper };
  }

  function clamp(value, min, max) {
    return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
  }

  function formatCurrency(value) {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      maximumFractionDigits: 0
    }).format(value);
  }

  function formatCompactCurrency(value) {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'USD',
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
      notation: 'compact'
    }).format(value);
  }

  function formatRange(lower, upper) {
    return `${formatCurrency(lower)} to ${formatCurrency(upper)}`;
  }

  function formatPctPoints(value) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
      return 'n/a';
    }
    if (value < 0.001) {
      return `${value.toFixed(6)} percentage points`;
    }
    if (value < 0.1) {
      return `${value.toFixed(4)} percentage points`;
    }
    if (value < 1) {
      return `${value.toFixed(3)} percentage points`;
    }
    return `${value.toFixed(2)} percentage points`;
  }

  function formatPercent(value) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
      return 'n/a';
    }
    return `${(value * 100).toFixed(value < 0.01 ? 2 : 1)}%`;
  }

  const globalIncome = parseMetric('pbc-src-income', { fallback: 14400 });
  const globalYears = parseMetric('pbc-src-years', { fallback: 48.5, allowPercent: true });
  const globalAge = parseMetric('pbc-src-age', { fallback: 30.5, allowPercent: true });
  const globalSavings = parseMetric('pbc-src-savings', { fallback: 3900 });
  const treatyIncome = parseMetric('pbc-src-treaty-income', { fallback: 14900000 });
  const wishIncome = parseMetric('pbc-src-wish-income', { fallback: 52100000 });
  const treatyHealth = parseMetric('pbc-src-treaty-health', { fallback: 982500 });
  const wishHealth = parseMetric('pbc-src-wish-health', { fallback: 2355000 });
  const destructNow = parseMetric('pbc-src-destruct-now', { fallback: 0.115, allowPercent: true });
  const destruct25 = parseMetric('pbc-src-destruct-25', { fallback: 2033, allowPercent: true });
  const destruct35 = parseMetric('pbc-src-destruct-35', { fallback: 2037, allowPercent: true });
  const destruct50 = parseMetric('pbc-src-destruct-50', { fallback: 2040, allowPercent: true });
  const globalGdp = parseMetric('pbc-src-global-gdp', { fallback: 1 });
  const currentGdp15 = parseMetric('pbc-src-current-gdp-15', { fallback: globalGdp.central });
  const currentGdp20 = parseMetric('pbc-src-current-gdp-20', { fallback: currentGdp15.central });
  const treatyGdp15 = parseMetric('pbc-src-treaty-gdp-15', { fallback: currentGdp15.central });
  const treatyGdp20 = parseMetric('pbc-src-treaty-gdp-20', { fallback: treatyGdp15.central });
  const wishGdp15 = parseMetric('pbc-src-wish-gdp-15', { fallback: treatyGdp15.central });
  const wishGdp20 = parseMetric('pbc-src-wish-gdp-20', { fallback: wishGdp15.central });
  const householdWealth = parseMetric('pbc-src-household-wealth', { fallback: globalSavings.central });
  const investableAssets = parseMetric('pbc-src-investable-assets', { fallback: householdWealth.central });
  const globalPopulation = parseMetric('pbc-src-population', { fallback: 1 });
  const defaultNetWorth = Math.max(0, householdWealth.central / Math.max(globalPopulation.central, 1));
  const defaultWealthExposure = clamp(investableAssets.central / Math.max(householdWealth.central, 1), 0, 1);

  const scenarioMap = {
    treaty: {
      label: 'Minimum Sustainable Trajectory ([1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@1-percent-treaty-paper-2025] [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025])',
      income: treatyIncome,
      health: treatyHealth
    },
    wishonia: {
      label: 'Optimal Governance Trajectory',
      income: wishIncome,
      health: wishHealth
    }
  };

  const scenarioInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-scenario');
  const ageInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-age');
  const incomeInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-income');
  const netWorthInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-networth');
  const wealthExposureInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-wealth-exposure');
  const savingsInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-savings');
  const contributionInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-contribution');
  const probabilityInput = document.getElementById('pbc-input-probability');
  const resetButton = document.getElementById('pbc-reset');
  const wealthChart = document.getElementById('pbc-wealth-chart');
  const chartScale = document.getElementById('pbc-chart-scale');

  function resetDefaults() {
    ageInput.value = Math.round(globalAge.central);
    incomeInput.value = Math.round(globalIncome.central);
    netWorthInput.value = Math.round(defaultNetWorth);
    wealthExposureInput.value = Math.round(defaultWealthExposure * 100);
    savingsInput.value = Math.round(globalSavings.central);
    contributionInput.value = Math.max(1, Math.round(globalSavings.central * 0.01));
    probabilityInput.value = '0.01';
    scenarioInput.value = 'treaty';
  }

  function scaledMetric(metric, scale) {
    return {
      central: metric.central * scale,
      lower: metric.lower * scale,
      upper: metric.upper * scale
    };
  }

  function setOutput(id, value) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = value;
    }
  }

  function interpolateGdp(year, gdp0, gdp15, gdp20) {
    const midYear = 15;
    const horizonYear = 20;
    if (year <= midYear) {
      return gdp0 * Math.pow(gdp15 / gdp0, year / midYear);
    }
    return gdp15 * Math.pow(gdp20 / gdp15, (year - midYear) / (horizonYear - midYear));
  }

  function wealthForGdp(netWorth, exposure, gdp) {
    const gdpMultiple = gdp / Math.max(globalGdp.central, 1);
    return netWorth * (1 + exposure * (gdpMultiple - 1));
  }

  function buildWealthSeries(netWorth, exposure) {
    const years = Array.from({ length: 21 }, function(_, index) { return index; });
    return {
      current: years.map(function(year) {
        return {
          year: year,
          value: wealthForGdp(netWorth, exposure, interpolateGdp(year, globalGdp.central, currentGdp15.central, currentGdp20.central))
        };
      }),
      treaty: years.map(function(year) {
        return {
          year: year,
          value: wealthForGdp(netWorth, exposure, interpolateGdp(year, globalGdp.central, treatyGdp15.central, treatyGdp20.central))
        };
      }),
      wishonia: years.map(function(year) {
        return {
          year: year,
          value: wealthForGdp(netWorth, exposure, interpolateGdp(year, globalGdp.central, wishGdp15.central, wishGdp20.central))
        };
      })
    };
  }

  function drawWealthChart(series) {
    if (!wealthChart) {
      return;
    }
    const width = 720;
    const height = 320;
    const margin = { top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 44, left: 88 };
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const allValues = series.current.concat(series.treaty, series.wishonia).map(function(point) { return point.value; });
    const maxValue = Math.max.apply(null, allValues.concat([1]));
    const xFor = function(year) {
      return margin.left + (year / 20) * plotWidth;
    };
    const yFor = function(value) {
      return margin.top + plotHeight - (value / maxValue) * plotHeight;
    };
    const pointsFor = function(points) {
      return points.map(function(point) {
        return `${xFor(point.year).toFixed(1)},${yFor(point.value).toFixed(1)}`;
      }).join(' ');
    };
    const yTicks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1];
    const xTicks = [0, 5, 10, 15, 20];
    const grid = yTicks.map(function(tick) {
      const y = margin.top + plotHeight - tick * plotHeight;
      return `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${y}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y2="${y}" stroke="rgba(60,43,16,0.12)" />` +
        `<text x="${margin.left - 12}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="#6a5a45">${formatCompactCurrency(maxValue * tick)}</text>`;
    }).join('') + xTicks.map(function(tick) {
      const x = xFor(tick);
      return `<line x1="${x}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${x}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}" stroke="rgba(60,43,16,0.08)" />` +
        `<text x="${x}" y="${height - 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#6a5a45">Y${tick}</text>`;
    }).join('');

    wealthChart.innerHTML =
      '<title id="pbc-wealth-chart-title">Net worth timeline by trajectory</title>' +
      '<desc id="pbc-wealth-chart-desc">Projected net worth under current, treaty, and optimal governance trajectories.</desc>' +
      `<rect x="0" y="0" width="${width}" height="${height}" fill="#fff" />` +
      grid +
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}" stroke="#6a5a45" />` +
      `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}" stroke="#6a5a45" />` +
      `<polyline fill="none" stroke="#7a6a56" stroke-width="3" points="${pointsFor(series.current)}" />` +
      `<polyline fill="none" stroke="#a04f1a" stroke-width="3.5" points="${pointsFor(series.treaty)}" />` +
      `<polyline fill="none" stroke="#0e5f47" stroke-width="3.5" points="${pointsFor(series.wishonia)}" />`;

    if (chartScale) {
      chartScale.textContent = `Top tick: ${formatCompactCurrency(maxValue)}`;
    }
  }

  function render() {
    const scenario = scenarioMap[scenarioInput.value] || scenarioMap.treaty;
    const age = clamp(Number.parseFloat(ageInput.value) || globalAge.central, 0, 120);
    const income = Math.max(1, Number.parseFloat(incomeInput.value) || globalIncome.central);
    const netWorth = Math.max(0, Number.parseFloat(netWorthInput.value) || 0);
    const wealthExposure = clamp((Number.parseFloat(wealthExposureInput.value) || 0) / 100, 0, 1);
    const savings = Math.max(1, Number.parseFloat(savingsInput.value) || globalSavings.central);
    const contribution = Math.max(1, Number.parseFloat(contributionInput.value) || 1);
    const probabilityPoints = Math.max(0, Number.parseFloat(probabilityInput.value) || 0);
    const probabilityFraction = probabilityPoints / 100;
    const wealthSeries = buildWealthSeries(netWorth, wealthExposure);
    const currentWealth20 = wealthSeries.current[20].value;
    const treatyWealth20 = wealthSeries.treaty[20].value;
    const wishWealth20 = wealthSeries.wishonia[20].value;
    const selectedWealth20 = scenarioInput.value === 'wishonia' ? wishWealth20 : treatyWealth20;
    const selectedWealthGap = selectedWealth20 - currentWealth20;

    const remainingYears = Math.max(1, globalYears.central + (globalAge.central - age));
    const incomeScale = income / globalIncome.central;
    const timeScale = remainingYears / globalYears.central;

    const personalIncome = scaledMetric(scenario.income, incomeScale * timeScale);
    const personalHealth = scaledMetric(scenario.health, timeScale);
    const personalBlend = {
      central: personalIncome.central + personalHealth.central,
      lower: personalIncome.lower + personalHealth.lower,
      upper: personalIncome.upper + personalHealth.upper
    };

    const evIncome = scaledMetric(personalIncome, probabilityFraction);
    const evBlend = scaledMetric(personalBlend, probabilityFraction);
    const breakEvenProbabilityIncome = contribution / Math.max(personalIncome.central, 1) * 100;
    const breakEvenProbabilityBlend = contribution / Math.max(personalBlend.central, 1) * 100;
    const savingsShare = contribution / savings;

    setOutput('pbc-output-income', formatCurrency(personalIncome.central));
    setOutput('pbc-output-income-meta', `Range: ${formatRange(personalIncome.lower, personalIncome.upper)}`);

    setOutput('pbc-output-health', formatCurrency(personalHealth.central));
    setOutput('pbc-output-health-meta', `Range: ${formatRange(personalHealth.lower, personalHealth.upper)}`);

    setOutput('pbc-output-blend', formatCurrency(personalBlend.central));
    setOutput('pbc-output-blend-meta', `Range: ${formatRange(personalBlend.lower, personalBlend.upper)}`);

    setOutput('pbc-output-wealth-gap', formatCompactCurrency(selectedWealthGap));
    setOutput('pbc-output-wealth-gap-meta', `Year 20: current ${formatCompactCurrency(currentWealth20)}, treaty ${formatCompactCurrency(treatyWealth20)}, optimal ${formatCompactCurrency(wishWealth20)}.`);

    setOutput('pbc-output-ev', formatCurrency(evBlend.central));
    setOutput('pbc-output-ev-meta', `Income-only EV: ${formatCurrency(evIncome.central)}. Blended range: ${formatRange(evBlend.lower, evBlend.upper)}`);

    setOutput('pbc-output-break-even', formatCurrency(evBlend.central));
    setOutput('pbc-output-break-even-meta', `At ${formatPctPoints(probabilityPoints)}, income-only break-even is ${formatCurrency(evIncome.central)}.`);

    setOutput('pbc-output-probability', formatPctPoints(breakEvenProbabilityBlend));
    setOutput('pbc-output-probability-meta', `Income-only break-even: ${formatPctPoints(breakEvenProbabilityIncome)}.`);

    drawWealthChart(wealthSeries);

    setOutput(
      'pbc-wealth-summary',
      `With ${formatCompactCurrency(netWorth)} in net worth and ${formatPercent(wealthExposure)} tied to the real economy, the year-20 wealth track is ${formatCompactCurrency(currentWealth20)} on the current trajectory, ${formatCompactCurrency(treatyWealth20)} under the 1% Treaty, and ${formatCompactCurrency(wishWealth20)} under optimal governance. This is the financial-wealth layer only. It excludes health value and any direct EOS equity return.`
    );

    setOutput(
      'pbc-summary',
      `At age ${age}, with ${formatCurrency(income)} annual income and ${formatCurrency(savings)} available savings, the ${scenario.label} implies ${formatCurrency(personalBlend.central)} in blended upside for you personally. A ${formatCurrency(contribution)} contribution is ${formatPercent(savingsShare)} of your available savings. If you believe that contribution raises success probability by ${formatPctPoints(probabilityPoints)}, its blended expected value is ${formatCurrency(evBlend.central)}. Meanwhile, the downside of not breaking the current loop is a destructive economy already at ${formatPercent(destructNow.central)} of GDP, reaching 35% (Terminal Parasitic Load) by ${destruct35.central}. Historical collapses consistently begin at 35-45% total extraction.`
    );
  }

  resetButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
    resetDefaults();
    render();
  });

  [scenarioInput, ageInput, incomeInput, netWorthInput, wealthExposureInput, savingsInput, contributionInput, probabilityInput].forEach(function(el) {
    el.addEventListener('input', render);
  });

  resetDefaults();
  render();
})();
</script>

## What This Means

The calculator has no feelings. It has arithmetic. Your contribution does not need to cause the treaty to pass. It needs to make it fractionally more likely. "Fractionally more likely" times "enormous upside" equals "large expected value." This is how insurance works. This is how venture capital works. You understand this math when it applies to stock portfolios. You ignore it when it applies to not dying.

Three things. Put your name on the EOS investor list in [Earth Optimization Services](../solution/earth-optimization-services.qmd) if you can legally invest. Answer the referendum questions at [warondisease.org](https://warondisease.org). Recruit two people. The phone script is at [The Most Important Secret in the World](../strategy/questions.qmd). Total time: less than it takes to order lunch. Expected value: considerably more than lunch.
